component.name: Moonglow
component.summary: External-display brightness, colour temperature, and global shortcuts

description.p: Moonglow drives external-monitor brightness over DDC/CI and follows a morning/evening colour-temperature schedule. Its settings window has brightness and colour-temperature sliders, a day/night range, global keyboard shortcuts, and a full command-line interface.
First stable Linux release: DDC/CI brightness, scheduled colour temperature, a desktop settings window with global shortcuts, CLI, and autostart.
